author: UncondemnedSinner
body:
I was the one who said that Collosus can drop upwards of 7k orn.  [Here in this post](https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/thle25/been_playing_2_weeks_just_turned_level_175_how_am/).

To get that you need the Luck Shrine, an ornate Deathbringer sword, and an ornate Reaper's Robe.   Add to this your lucky coins..... and all those boosts affect the orn drops.

As a T7 player --- I farmed 4.5 MILLION Orn in one 4 hour trip by simply keeping my shrines active and focusing ONLY on boss battles along the way.   That is why I was able to purchase Leviathan the moment I turned T8, as I mentioned in my post.   That car trip helped me greatly as I went from level 165 to Level 175 ..... in just 4 hours.   Bosses really do give you what you need, if you have all your shrines active..... and the right gear.

author: Red_Panda48
body:
As you level up you will gain access to monsters/bosses that drop more orns/exp then lower level ones. On top of that you will eventually get a band of gods which is a huge multiplier for both. Pair 2 bogs with venins/questing weapons, and orn armor and it's a noticeable increase.  That's how some people are getting significantly more orns from some monsters than you.

A lot of this gear unlocks at t9 though, so leveling up should be your priority. Ornate/Legendary rings of restraint can help if your struggling for orns for your next class, but I would suggest against using them as much as you can.

author: shadowoflillith
body: It is very "grindy", yes, but play around with some of your other equipment for a while too, you might find a better combination. It took me a LONG time to get a good combo. And definitely trade your rings of restraint for some other accessories, I found them to be somewhat useful when I first started out, but there are much better accessories for when you start gaining levels.
